steps.title: The lean math
lines: Each fired survivor's weight (0.5, 0.75 or 1.0 - a strength score set by its worst recent-window hit rate, not a number of points) is added on the side its mechanism names; weights on opposite sides offset; the net is capped at +/-1.5. Watch angles add 0. How the score is built: the site appendix, How we grade.

total: sum of fired weights: nothing fired; net 0; cap +/-1.5 -> lean none.

steps.title: The line check
lines: The line check protects against chasing a number the market has already taken. It compares two different things on purpose: the market's movement since the opener, measured in points of the line, against the strength score, used as a staleness budget. Once the number has moved toward the lean by as much as the score, the read counts as spent. That coupling is a named, unvalidated rule (references/interpretation.yaml, movement_rule).
